title: Internal Appeal Member Share Percent Schedule, Insurance Coverage & Claims Contracted Commercial Plans
content:
**Schedule — member share percent on internal appeals filed by Halverson Clinical Laboratories with contracted commercial plans under Insurance Coverage & Claims.**

The internal appeal's member share percent follows the deductible amounts assigned to the member on the coverage within the last twelve months:

| Deductible amounts assigned on the coverage within the last twelve months | Member share percent |
|---|---|
| Reach 250.00 USD (the deductible satisfied amount) | 20 percent (coinsurance phase) |
| Above zero but below 250.00 USD | 50 percent (deductible phase) |
| None assigned | 15 percent |

The internal appeal's member portion is its valued charges times its member share percent, divided by one hundred.

### Footnotes

1. *Deductible amounts* are the patient-responsibility lines of the deductible type assigned on the coverage, dated within the last twelve months; copays, coinsurance and other responsibility types do not count toward the 250.00 USD.
2. "Reach" includes equality: a total of exactly 250.00 USD takes the coinsurance phase percent.

### Boundary rows (hypothetical totals)

| Deductible total | Percent |
|---|---|
| 250.00 | 20 |
| 249.99 | 50 |
| 0.01 | 50 |
| 0.00 | 15 |

### Worked line (hypothetical)

Valued charges of 400.00 USD with 180.00 USD of deductible assigned in the twelve months: the percent is 50, and the member portion is 400.00 times 50, divided by one hundred, 200.00 USD.
